description: This file defines the EnforcerActor class, an Akka actor responsible for enforcing policies and ACLs on signals within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages enforcement providers, constructs enforcement workflows using Akka Streams, and integrates with caching mechanisms to optimize enforcement decisions.

classes.name: EnforcerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that enforces policies or ACLs on incoming signals by coordinating enforcement providers and managing enforcement workflows.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for the EnforcerActor with all dependencies configured.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Overrides the method to create and return the main sink for processing incoming enforcement requests.

methods.name: assembleSink
methods.description: Builds the Akka Streams flow graph that processes enforcement tasks and schedules enforcement actions.
